name: docguard
description: Detects when code changes require documentation updates and proposes patches.

commands.title: DocGuard: Analyze Workspace Changes with LLM Patch
DocGuard: Apply Safe Fallback Documentation Patch

docguard.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to run the DocGuard runtime.

docguard.runtimeMode.description: Runtime communication mode. CLI is used by the MVP.

docguard.autoAnalyzeOnSave.description: Analyze workspace changes after saving a file.

docguard.classifierArchitecture.description: Decision architecture. Use hybrid_router for the fast VS Code demo; staged/single opt into the HF classifier when available.

docguard.analysisBackend.description: Documentation update decision backend. Use llm-openai-compatible for an LLM-first live demo; hybrid keeps the measured guardrail/router path.

docguard.analysisModel.description: Model name for LLM-first documentation update analysis.

docguard.analysisMaxNewTokens.description: Maximum new tokens for LLM analysis JSON generation.

docguard.analysisTemperature.description: Sampling temperature for LLM analysis JSON generation.

docguard.patchBackend.description: Documentation patch generator. Use llm-openai-compatible or llm-ollama for stronger external/local model servers with verifier metadata.

docguard.patchModel.description: Patch-generation model name for the selected LLM backend.

docguard.patchMaxNewTokens.description: Maximum new tokens for LLM patch generation.

docguard.patchTemperature.description: Sampling temperature for LLM patch generation.

docguard.llmBaseUrl.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible LLM base URL passed to the Python runtime when DOCGUARD_LLM_BASE_URL is not set in the VS Code process.

docguard.llmApiKeyEnvironmentVariable.description: Name of the environment variable that contains the LLM API key. Keep the key in your shell environment, not in repository files.

docguard.runtimeTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for the Python runtime before terminating the process.

docguard.showDiagnostics.description: Show runtime diagnostics in the panel.
